statement_en: DTS launched October 28, 2026 as a voluntary service enabling eligible DTC Participants to tokenize DTC-custodied securities.
statement_zh: DTS于2026年10月28日正式上线，是一项自愿性服务，允许符合条件的DTC参与者对DTC托管证券进行代币化。
evidence_quote: today launched the DTCC Tokenization Service (DTS)
limitation: Launch announcement only; no post-launch operational metrics supplied.

statement_en: Twenty DTC Participants signed agreements to access DTS at launch; future users to be onboarded on a rolling basis. Signed agreements are not confirmed active users.
statement_zh: 上线时有20家DTC参与者签署了DTS接入协议；未来用户将滚动式入驻。签署协议不等于活跃用户。
evidence_quote: 20 DTC Participants (clients) have signed agreements to access DTS
limitation: Signed agreements ≠ active or transacting users; no active-user count found in supplied documents.

statement_en: SEC Division of Trading and Markets staff issued a no-action position on December 11, 2025, covering Reg SCI, Exchange Act Section 19(b)/Rule 19b-4, and Rules 17Ad-22(e) and 17Ad-25(i)/(j) for the Preliminary Base Version. This is a staff no-action position, not blanket Commission approval.
statement_zh: SEC交易与市场部门工作人员于2025年12月11日就初步基础版本发布不采取行动立场，涵盖Reg SCI等条款。这是工作人员立场，非委员会全面批准。
evidence_quote: the Staff would not recommend enforcement
limitation: Partial web-reader extract of pages 0–10 of a 39-page PDF; full document not directly accessible. Staff position subject to modification or revocation at any time.

statement_en: Eligible securities include Russell1000 constituents at pilot launch and later additions (including subsequent index removals), U.S. Treasury bills/bonds/notes, and ETFs tracking major indices.
statement_zh: 合格证券包括试点上线时的罗素1000成分股及其后新增证券（即使其后被移出指数）、美国国债及追踪主要指数的ETF。
evidence_quote: limited to (i) securities in the Russell 1000 Index
limitation: The letter expressly preserves eligibility despite subsequent Russell1000 index removal; index removal alone must not be coded as loss of eligibility.

statement_en: DTC will not ascribe collateral value or settlement value to any Tokenized Entitlements for purposes of DTC risk management, including Net Debit Cap or Collateral Monitor calculations.
statement_zh: DTC不会将任何代币化权益赋予抵押品价值或结算价值，不用于DTC风险管理（包括净借记上限或抵押品监控）计算。
limitation: This is a DTC internal risk management restriction; external CCP collateral workflows using tokenized assets are a separate matter not precluded by this restriction.

statement_en: LedgerScan and Factory are designated Tier 2 systems with a four-hour recovery time objective, two-minute maximum data loss, and annual out-of-region DR testing. They are physically and logically separate from DTC's SCI clearing/settlement systems.
statement_zh: LedgerScan和Factory被指定为二级系统，恢复时间目标为四小时，最大数据丢失两分钟，并须进行年度异地灾难恢复测试，且与DTC的SCI清算/结算系统物理和逻辑隔离。
evidence_quote: a maximum of a four-hour recovery time objective
limitation: These are design commitments stated in the no-action request; actual tested recovery performance not reported in supplied documents.

statement_en: Tokens are only transferable to Registered Wallets of DTC Participants. DTC retains technological capability to transfer tokens to address Conditions Requiring Reversal (erroneous entries, lost tokens, malfeasance).
statement_zh: 代币仅可转移至DTC参与者的已注册钱包。DTC保留技术能力，可在满足"需要撤销条件"时（错误记录、丢失代币、不当行为）转移代币。
evidence_quote: Tokens are only transferrable to Registered Wallets
limitation: Reversal capability is a design commitment; frequency or success rate of reversals not found in supplied documents.

statement_en: Conversion orders (tokenization/de-tokenization) may be submitted Monday–Friday 2:00 a.m.–6:00 p.m. ET; token transfers between Registered Wallets may occur 24/7.
statement_zh: 转换指令（代币化/去代币化）可在周一至周五美东时间凌晨2点至下午6点提交；已注册钱包之间的代币转移可全天候进行。
evidence_quote: orders) may be submitted to DTC Monday through Friday between 2:00 a.m. and 6:00 p.m.
limitation: Operating window is a policy parameter; actual conversion volumes and queue depths not available.
